Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with pain and
swelling over the distal radius of the left wrist. Imaging and examination findings
clearly confirm a distal radius fracture. Over the course of 11 visits, the patient was
managed with immobilization, progressive range-of-motion exercises, and scheduled
follow-up imaging to monitor alignment and healing. Treatment followed a usual course
and tapered as the patient improved, with pain and function steadily returning. The
patient reports a remote strain in the same region years ago that resolved completely
without lasting limitation. At this time it is not yet clear whether the present injury
arose from this crash, and causation review is ongoing. Billnig records show no
repeated charges for the same services. Discharge plan includes home exercise
instructions and return precautions, with reassessment as needed.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
